method: Built-in image_gen; reference image edits; three comparison images with steel and graphite surface variants.

jobs.name: arranque
jobs.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup, precise recoloring of an existing embedded touchscreen UI.
The input image is the EDIT TARGET, a real 800 x 480 screenshot from the user's current Klipper / Portal printer panel. Produce ONE raster comparison image containing TWO complete faithful recolored copies of this exact screen, side by side. This is a color proposal, not a redesign. Preserve every original position, proportion, icon shape, font appearance, label, number, illustration, and layout. All text must remain clear and legible. No new buttons, no removed controls, no perspective, no hardware device, no 3D, no glow, no gradients.
Canvas composition: landscape approximately 1728 x 640. Two flat front-facing 800 x 480 screen previews at equal scale, aligned horizontally with generous separation and a small caption above each. Entire exterior presentation background is off-white #E8ECEB. Caption above LEFT preview: "GRIS ACERO · #4B575D". Caption above RIGHT preview: "NEGRO GRAFITO · #20272B". Caption text dark graphite #20272B. Do not place comparison captions inside the UI.
Exact palette rules for BOTH screens:
- All exposed full-screen background and gutters become solid concrete grey #A6ADAE.
- LEFT: all card / button / header / inset panel background fills become solid steel grey #4B575D.
- RIGHT: the identical surfaces become solid graphite black #20272B.
- Existing cyan / blue icon fills and blue highlights become portal blue #00A6FF. Recolor Aperture cyan blades to the same portal blue while preserving all aperture geometry and dark separators.
- Existing green / yellow / amber / orange action icon fills and status accents become portal orange #FF8A1C. All orange temperatures and progress remain this portal orange. No green accents.
- Signal red #D94A3A is reserved for emergency stop, stop and cancel-print action icons. Preserve their action meanings. Any decorative red in the Klipper logo may be orange to stay within the requested palette; preserve its geometry.
- Primary labels and numerical readings on dark surfaces are laboratory white #E8ECEB. Secondary labels remain light and readable. Screen labels directly on concrete background may use graphite for legibility.
- Panel borders are subtle neutral grey, not saturated cyan. Keep corners and thin border geometry identical to source.
- Keep raster character artwork and any photographic content intact; preserve its appearance, with only cyan eye highlights shifted to portal blue.
The two previews must differ ONLY in surface/card fill grey: left #4B575D versus right #20272B. Background #A6ADAE, all positions, content, text, icons, and other colors must match exactly between the two previews.

Screen: ARRANQUE. Preserve the startup header "APERTURE", "Cargando...", "KLIPPER", the Wi-Fi and Klipper connection groups, the central Aperture logo, the AJUSTES button and lower "Conectando Wi-Fi..." panel. Preserve the faint structural grid behind the content, making it low-contrast steel grey on the concrete background. Header "Cargando..." and existing cyan interface details are portal blue; "Esperando" is portal orange. No invented progress percentages.
